entry.name: rnbo_matrix~
entry.description: matrix~ is an array of signal connectors and mixers (adders). It can have any number of inlets and outlets. Signals entering at each inlet can be routed to one or more of the outlets, with a variable amount of gain. If an outlet is connected to more than one inlet, its output signal is the sum of the signals from the inlets.

arguments.name: incount
arguments.description: Specify the number of inputs to be routed

arguments.name: outcount
arguments.description: Specify the number of outputs to route to
